definitions.explanation: The amount of water contained in a material, usually expressed as a percentage. Used in contexts like soil science, food, materials engineering, and cosmetics.

examples.japanese: {土|つち}の{含水量|がんすいりょう}を{測|はか}る。
examples.english: We measure the water content of the soil.

examples.japanese: この{木材|もくざい}は{含水量|がんすいりょう}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This lumber has a high moisture content.

examples.japanese: パンを{焼|や}くときは、{生地|きじ}の{含水量|がんすいりょう}によって{出来上|できあ}がりが{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: When baking bread, the moisture content of the dough greatly affects the final result.

notes:
Compound of {含水|がんすい} (containing water) + {量|りょう} (amount).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {含水量|がんすいりょう}が{高|たか}い: has high water content
- {含水量|がんすいりょう}が{低|ひく}い: has low water content
- {含水量|がんすいりょう}を{測|はか}る: to measure the water content
- {含水量|がんすいりょう}を{調|しら}べる: to check the moisture level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水分|すいぶん}: moisture; water — more general, used in everyday contexts about food, skin, etc.
- {湿度|しつど}: humidity — water in the air, not in a material
- {水分量|すいぶんりょう}: moisture amount — more casual everyday equivalent
